item.title: Set up a game in your chat
item.summary: Ask Murph to set up a one-on-one game in a chat with just you, the other player and Murph.
item.details: Choose your tasks, days, length, start day and a prize or dare. Murph lays out the terms, and the other player agrees in chat before the game starts. You can also accept a Play again rematch in that chat. Both players need a game profile in the Murph app. Games remain invite only.
